method.root_action: action at offset 0 from the repeated state
method.opponent_response: action at offset 1, after the common root action
method.next_root_player_action: action at offset 2, after the opponent response
method.outcome: terminal winner from the repeated state's side-to-move perspective
method.pairing: all positive/negative occurrence pairs within each exact encoded state
method.action_source: uniquely reconstructed from consecutive recorded states; not a stored policy label

interpretation_limits: Observational attribution only; no action was intervened on and no game was re-simulated.
Opponent response comparisons are conditioned on the same exact root state and same observed root action.
An association between a response and terminal outcome does not establish causation or response quality.
The dataset does not store policy/action fields; actions are uniquely reconstructed from state transitions.
This audit does not modify training, targets, loss, checkpoints, replay, PUCT, or source dataset.
